title.zh: 卷三百〇二 列傳第六十一 王臻 魚周詢 賈黯 李京 吳鼎臣 呂景初 馬遵 吳及 范師道 李絢 何中立 沈邈
title.en: Volume 302 Biographies 61: Wang Zhen, Yu Zhouxun, Jia An, Li Jing, Wu Dingchen, Lu Jingchu, Ma Zun, Wu Ji, Fan Shidao, Li Xuan, He Zhongli, Shen Miao
title.raw: 卷三百〇二 列傳第六十一 王臻 魚周詢 賈黯 李京 吳鼎臣 呂景初 馬遵 吳及 范師道 李絢 何中立 沈邈 Volume 302 Biographies 61: Wang Zhen, Yu Zhouxun, Jia An, Li Jing, Wu Dingchen, Lu Jingchu, Ma Zun, Wu Ji, Fan Shidao, Li Xuan, He Zhongli, Shen Miao

sentences.zh: 王臻，字及之，潁州汝陰人。

translations.literal: Wang Zhen, courtesy name Jizhi, was a native of Ruyin in Ying Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhen, whose courtesy name was Jizhi, came from Ruyin in Ying Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 始就學，能文辭。

translations.literal: When he first took up study, he was able at literary composition.
translations.idiomatic: From the start of his studies he showed talent for literary composition.

sentences.zh: 曾致堯知壽州，有時名，臻以文數十篇往見，致堯覽之，歎曰：「潁、汝固多奇士。」

translations.literal: Zeng Zhiyao was prefect of Shou Prefecture and had a reputation of the time; Zhen took several tens of essays to call on him. Zhiyao read them and sighed, saying: "Ying and Ru indeed have many extraordinary gentlemen."
translations.idiomatic: Zeng Zhiyao, who was prefect of Shou Prefecture and enjoyed contemporary renown, received a visit from Zhen bearing several dozen essays. After reading them, Zhiyao sighed and said, "The Ying and Ru regions truly produce many remarkable men."

sentences.zh: 舉進士中第，為大理評事，歷知舒城、會昌縣，通判徐、定二州，以殿中丞知兗州，特遷監察御史。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination and was made an evaluator of the Court of Judicial Review; he successively served as magistrate of Shucheng and Huichang counties, as vice-prefect of Xu and Ding prefectures, and as Defender-in-Chief of the Palace Administration governing Yan Prefecture; he was specially promoted to Investigating Censor.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen passed the jinshi examination and was appointed an evaluator of the Court of Judicial Review. He later served as magistrate of Shucheng and Huichang counties, as vice-prefect of Xu and Ding prefectures, and as Defender-in-Chief of the Palace Administration governing Yan Prefecture, before receiving a special promotion to Investigating Censor.

sentences.zh: 中使就營景靈宮、太極觀，臻佐助工費有勞，遷殿中侍御史，擢淮南轉運副使。

translations.literal: When palace envoys came to oversee construction of the Jingling Palace and the Taiji Abbey, Zhen assisted in managing labor costs with merit and was transferred to Attending Palace Censor, then promoted to Vice Commissioner of the Huainan Transport Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: While palace envoys supervised construction of the Jingling Palace and the Taiji Abbey, Zhen helped manage labor expenses with distinction. He was transferred to Attending Palace Censor and then promoted to Vice Commissioner of the Huainan Transport Circuit.

sentences.zh: 時發運司建議浚淮南漕渠，廢諸堰，臻言：「揚州召伯堰，實謝安為之，人思其功，以比召伯，不可廢也。

translations.literal: At the time the Transport Commission proposed dredging the Huainan canal and abolishing the various dams. Zhen said: "Yang Prefecture's Duke of Shao Dam was in fact built by Xie An; the people cherish his achievement and compare him to the Duke of Shao—it cannot be abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Transport Commission then proposed dredging the Huainan canal and dismantling the various dams. Zhen argued, "The Duke of Shao Dam at Yang Prefecture was actually built by Xie An. The people still honor his achievement and liken him to the Duke of Shao—it must not be abandoned.

sentences.zh: 浚渠亦無所益。」

translations.literal: Dredging the canal would also bring no benefit."
translations.idiomatic: Dredging the canal would bring no real benefit either."

sentences.zh: 召為三司度支判官，而發運司卒浚渠以通漕，臻坐前異議，降監察御史、知睦州。

translations.literal: He was summoned to serve as an adjudicator in the Fiscal Affairs Bureau of the Three Offices, but the Transport Commission in the end dredged the canal to open grain transport. Because of his earlier dissent, Zhen was demoted to Investigating Censor and made prefect of Mu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was recalled to serve as an adjudicator in the Fiscal Affairs Bureau of the Three Offices, but the Transport Commission ultimately dredged the canal to open grain transport. Zhen was punished for his earlier opposition: he was demoted to Investigating Censor and appointed prefect of Mu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 道復官，徙福州。

translations.literal: On the road his office was restored and he was transferred to Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: While traveling he was restored to office and transferred to Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 閩人欲報仇，或先食野葛，而後趨仇家求鬥，即死其處，以誣仇人。

translations.literal: The people of Min wished to take revenge; some would first eat wild kudzu and then rush to the enemy's house to fight, dying on the spot so as to frame the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: In Min, men seeking revenge would sometimes eat wild kudzu first, then rush to a foe's house to brawl and die on the spot, framing their enemy for the death.

sentences.zh: 臻辨察格鬥狀，被誣者往往釋去，俗為之少變。

translations.literal: Zhen examined the circumstances of brawls and often released the falsely accused, and the custom thereby changed somewhat.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen scrutinized brawl cases and often released the falsely accused, and the custom gradually changed.

sentences.zh: 又民間數以火訛相驚，悉捕首惡杖之，流海上，民乃定。

translations.literal: Moreover, among the people several times used fire to spread false alarms with one another; he arrested all the ringleaders and caned them, exiling them to the sea, and the people then settled down.
translations.idiomatic: When locals repeatedly spread false fire alarms, he arrested the ringleaders, had them beaten, and exiled them overseas, after which the people settled down.

sentences.zh: 魚周詢

translations.literal: Yu Zhouxun
translations.idiomatic: Yu Zhouxun

sentences.zh: 魚周詢，字裕之，開封雍丘人。

translations.literal: Yu Zhouxun, courtesy name Yuzhi, was a native of Yongqiu in Kaifeng.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Zhouxun, whose courtesy name was Yuzhi, came from Yongqiu in Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 早孤，好學。

translations.literal: Orphaned early, he loved learning.
translations.idiomatic: Orphaned young, he devoted himself to learning.

sentences.zh: 舉進士中第，為大理評事，歷知南華、分宜、靜海三縣，遷太常博士、通判漢州。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination and was made an evaluator of the Court of Judicial Review; he successively governed Nanhua, Fenyi, and Jinghai counties, was transferred to Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and served as vice-prefect of Han Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination and was appointed an evaluator of the Court of Judicial Review. He successively governed Nanhua, Fenyi, and Jinghai counties, became Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, and served as vice-prefect of Han Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 城中夜有火，部眾救之，植劍於前曰：「攘一物者斬！」

translations.literal: At night there was a fire in the city; the command staff went to rescue it. He planted his sword before them and said: "Whoever seizes one thing shall be beheaded!"
translations.idiomatic: When fire broke out in the city at night, his command staff rushed to fight it. He planted his sword before them and declared, "Anyone who seizes so much as one object will be beheaded!"

sentences.zh: 火止，民無所失亡。

translations.literal: The fire stopped and the people lost nothing.
translations.idiomatic: The blaze was extinguished and the people lost nothing.

sentences.zh: 以尚書屯田員外郎知真州，徙提點荊湖南路刑獄。

translations.literal: As Outer Gentleman of the Directorate of Imperial Granaries he governed Zhen Prefecture, then was transferred to Judicial Intendant of the Jinghu South Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: As Outer Gentleman of the Directorate of Imperial Granaries he governed Zhen Prefecture, then was transferred to Judicial Intendant of the Jinghu South Circuit.

sentences.zh: 求便郡，知安州，徙蔡州，召為侍御史。

translations.literal: He sought a convenient prefecture, governed An Prefecture, was transferred to Cai Prefecture, and was summoned as Attending Censor.
translations.idiomatic: Seeking a more convenient prefecture, he governed An Prefecture, then Cai Prefecture, and was summoned to serve as Attending Censor.

sentences.zh: 陝西用兵，科斂煩數，命安撫京西路，還賜緋衣銀魚。

translations.literal: With military campaigns in Shaanxi, levies and exactions were frequent and troublesome; he was ordered to pacify the Jingxi Circuit and on his return was granted crimson robes and a silver fish tally.
translations.idiomatic: When warfare in Shaanxi multiplied levies and exactions, he was ordered to pacify the Jingxi Circuit. On his return he was granted crimson robes and a silver fish tally.

sentences.zh: 為開封府判官，又使陝西刺民兵，判三司理欠、憑由司。

translations.literal: He served as an adjudicator of the Kaifeng prefectural government, was again sent to Shaanxi to inspect militia, and adjudicated the Arrears and Voucher offices of the Three Offices.
translations.idiomatic: He served as an adjudicator of the Kaifeng government, was again sent to Shaanxi to inspect militia, and adjudicated the Arrears and Voucher offices of the Three Offices.

sentences.zh: 進起居舍人、知諫院，固辭，乃以尚書戶部員外郎兼侍御史知雜事，為三司鹽鐵副使。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Drafting Attendant and made Remonstrance Officer; he firmly declined, and so was made Outer Gentleman of the Household Ministry while concurrently serving as Attending Censor with supervisory duties and as Vice Commissioner of the Salt and Iron Monopoly.
translations.idiomatic: Promoted to Drafting Attendant and offered the post of Remonstrance Officer, he firmly declined and instead became Outer Gentleman of the Household Ministry while concurrently serving as Attending Censor with supervisory duties and as Vice Commissioner of the Salt and Iron Monopoly.

sentences.zh: 時渭州城水洛，尹洙、鄭戩爭未決，詔周詢與都轉運使程戡相利害。

translations.literal: At the time Weizhou city at Shuiluo was disputed between Yin Zhu and Zheng Yan without resolution; the court ordered Zhouxun and the circuit transport commissioner Cheng Kan to weigh the advantages and disadvantages.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the fortification of Shuiluo at Weizhou was disputed between Yin Zhu and Zheng Yan without resolution; the court ordered Zhouxun and Circuit Transport Commissioner Cheng Kan to weigh the pros and cons.

sentences.zh: 周詢是戩議，遂城之。

translations.literal: Zhouxun sided with Yan's proposal, and the city was built.
translations.idiomatic: Zhouxun sided with Yan's proposal, and the fort was built.

sentences.zh: 遷吏部員外郎，擢天章閣待制、知成德軍，徙河北都轉運使，拜右諫議大夫、權御史中丞。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Outer Gentleman of the Ministry of Personnel, promoted to Hanlin Attendant of the Heavenly Writings Hall governing the Chengde Army, moved to Hebei Circuit Transport Commissioner, and appointed Right Remonstrance Officer with acting authority as Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Outer Gentleman of the Ministry of Personnel, promoted to Hanlin Attendant of the Heavenly Writings Hall governing the Chengde Army, moved to Hebei Circuit Transport Commissioner, and appointed Right Remonstrance Officer with acting authority as Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 慶曆八年，手詔近臣訪天下之務。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Qingli, the emperor by his own hand summoned close ministers to inquire into affairs under Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Qingli, the emperor personally summoned close ministers to inquire into affairs throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 周詢對曰：

translations.literal: Zhouxun replied:
translations.idiomatic: Zhouxun replied:

sentences.zh: 「陛下患西陲禦備，天下繹騷，趣募兵士，急調軍食，雖常賦有增，而經用不足。

translations.literal: "Your Majesty worries over defense of the western borderlands; the realm is unsettled; you hasten to recruit soldiers and urgently adjust military provisions. Though regular taxes have been increased, routine expenditures are still insufficient.
translations.idiomatic: "Your Majesty worries over defending the western frontier; the realm is unsettled; you rush to recruit soldiers and urgently adjust military supplies. Though regular taxes have risen, routine expenditures still fall short.

sentences.zh: 臣以謂唐季及五代，強臣專地，中國所制，疆域非廣。

translations.literal: Your servant considers that in the late Tang and Five Dynasties, powerful ministers held territory exclusively and what the central state controlled was not broad in territory.
translations.idiomatic: I believe that in the late Tang and Five Dynasties, powerful ministers held territory exclusively, and the central state controlled a far smaller domain.

sentences.zh: 及祖宗有天下，俘吳、楚、蜀、晉，北捍獯鬻，西服羌戎，所用甲兵，所入租賦，比之於今，其數尚寡。

translations.literal: When our founding emperors possessed the realm, they captured Wu, Chu, Shu, and Jin, defended the north against the Xiongnu, and subjugated the Qiang and Rong on the west—the armor and weapons used and the rents and taxes received, compared with today, were still fewer in number.
translations.idiomatic: When our founding emperors won the realm, they subdued Wu, Chu, Shu, and Jin, held the north against the northern tribes, and pacified the Qiang and Rong in the west—yet the arms they deployed and the rents and taxes they collected were still fewer than today's.

sentences.zh: 然而摧堅震敵，軍府無空虛之弊，縣官無煩費之勞，蓋賞信罰必，將選兵精之效也。

translations.literal: Yet in crushing the hard and shaking the enemy, the military offices had no empty-treasury harm and the government had no wasteful-expense toil—this was surely the effect of sure rewards and sure punishments, of choosing generals and refining troops.
translations.idiomatic: Yet they crushed hardened foes and shook enemy states while military offices suffered no empty treasuries and the government bore no wasteful burdens—surely the fruit of certain rewards and punishments, of choosing generals and training troops well.

sentences.zh: 近元昊背惠，西方宿師，朝廷用空疏闒茸者為偏裨，以遊惰怯懦者備行伍，故大舉即大敗，小戰輒小奔，徒日費千金，度支不給，賣官鬻爵，淆雜仕流，以鐵為錢，隳壞國法，而又官立鹽禁，驅民齎輦，蕩析恒產，怨諮盈路。

translations.literal: Recently Yuan Hao betrayed favor; troops were long stationed in the west; the court used empty and incompetent men as deputies and idle, cowardly men to fill the ranks—thus great campaigns meant great defeat and small battles meant small flight, wasting a thousand gold a day until the fiscal office could not supply, selling offices and peddling ranks, mixing the career streams, making coin of iron and ruining state law; moreover the government established a salt monopoly and drove the people to carry supplies, dissolving their permanent property, with complaints filling the roads.
translations.idiomatic: Recently Yuan Hao betrayed imperial favor; troops long garrisoned the west; the court appointed hollow, incompetent men as deputies and idle cowards to fill the ranks—so great campaigns brought great defeats and small battles brought routs, wasting a thousand gold a day until the fiscal office could not keep up, selling offices and peddling ranks, adulterating the career streams, coining iron money and ruining state law; the government also monopolized salt and drove the people to haul supplies, dissolving their livelihoods until complaints filled the roads.

sentences.zh: 去秋水旱繼作，今春饑饉相屬，生靈重困，於茲為劇。

translations.literal: Last autumn floods and droughts came in succession; this spring famine followed in series—the living are heavily afflicted; at this point it is severe.
translations.idiomatic: Last autumn floods and droughts came in succession; this spring famine followed in waves—the people are gravely afflicted, and the crisis is acute.

sentences.zh: 今元昊幼子新立，乃朝廷寬財用、惜民力之時也，速宜經度，以紓匱乏。

translations.literal: Now Yuan Hao's young son has newly taken the throne—this is the time for the court to ease fiscal burdens and cherish the people's strength. Plans should quickly be laid to relieve exhaustion.
translations.idiomatic: Now that Yuan Hao's young son has newly succeeded, this is the moment for the court to ease fiscal burdens and spare the people's strength. Plans should be made at once to relieve want.

sentences.zh: 願委安撫使與本路守邊、掌計臣僚同議，裁減冗兵，節抑浮費，禁止橫斂，廩假貧民，去武臣之庸懦，出守宰之貪殘。

translations.literal: I wish that pacification commissioners be entrusted, together with border-guarding and fiscal officials of this circuit, to deliberate, cut redundant troops, restrain wasteful spending, forbid arbitrary levies, lend grain to the poor, remove cowardly military officials, and drive out greedy and cruel prefects and magistrates.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that pacification commissioners deliberate with border and fiscal officials of this circuit to cut redundant troops, curb wasteful spending, forbid arbitrary levies, lend grain to the poor, remove cowardly military officers, and drive out greedy, cruel prefects and magistrates.

sentences.zh: 仍冀特發宸衷，出內帑錢助關陝費，使通鹽商之利，改錢幣之法，宣布德澤，與民休息。

translations.literal: I also hope Your Majesty will specially issue a decree from the inner heart, draw palace funds to aid Guan and Shaanxi expenses, open the profits of salt merchants, reform the currency law, proclaim virtuous grace, and let the people rest.
translations.idiomatic: I also hope Your Majesty will issue a decree from the inner heart, draw palace funds to aid Guan and Shaanxi, open trade profits for salt merchants, reform the currency, proclaim virtuous grace, and let the people rest.

sentences.zh: 然後勸勉農桑，隱括稅籍，收遺利，抑兼並，則公有羨財，私有餘力矣。

translations.literal: Then encourage farming and sericulture, audit tax registers, recover lost revenues, and restrain annexation—then the public will have surplus wealth and the private will have surplus strength.
translations.idiomatic: Then encourage farming and sericulture, audit tax registers, recover lost revenues, and restrain annexation—so the state will have surplus wealth and households surplus strength.

sentences.zh: 陛下患承平寖久，仕進多門，人污政濫，員多闕少，滋長奔競，靡費廩祿。

translations.literal: Your Majesty worries that long peace has gradually grown deep, that entry into office has many gates, that men stain government and it is diluted, that posts are many and vacancies few, that scrambling for advancement grows, and that salary grain is wasted.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty worries that long peace has bred many paths to office, that men corrupt government and posts multiply while vacancies shrink, that competition for advancement grows, and that salary grain is wasted.

sentences.zh: 臣以謂國家於製舉、進士、明經之外，復有任子、流外之補，負瑕釁、服輿臺者，亦置班列。

translations.literal: Your servant considers that apart from the regular examinations, jinshi, and classics degrees, the state also has appointment of sons by privilege and supplemental entry from clerical ranks; those bearing blemishes who served in chariot and stable offices are also placed in the roster.
translations.idiomatic: Apart from the regular examinations, jinshi, and classics degrees, the state also appoints sons by privilege and supplements clerical ranks; even men bearing blemishes who served in chariot and stable offices are placed on the roster.

sentences.zh: 歷年既久，紛猥塞路，求人任事，適用者鮮，而又亟更數易，交錯道塗，額置有常，詔除無限，凡守一闕，動逾再期。

translations.literal: Years have long passed and the confused crowd blocks the road; in seeking men to assign affairs, those fit for use are few. Moreover offices change repeatedly and paths cross; quotas are fixed but edicts of appointment are unlimited—for any who hold one vacancy, it often exceeds two terms.
translations.idiomatic: Years have passed until the throng blocks the road; among those sought for office, few are fit. Offices change repeatedly and paths cross; quotas are fixed but appointment edicts are unlimited—holders of a single vacancy often exceed two terms.

sentences.zh: 預閫籍、服武弁者，坐費水衡之給，虛計歲考之期；

translations.literal: Those in the inner register wearing military caps sit wasting the Water Balance Office's provisions and idle away the years of annual review;
translations.idiomatic: Those in the inner register wearing military caps sit wasting the Water Balance Office's provisions and idle away their annual review periods;

sentences.zh: 赴銓調、守選格者，居多困乏之歎，行寡廉恥之風。

translations.literal: those going to the Board of Appointments and awaiting selection mostly sigh at poverty and distress, and the conduct of little integrity and shame prevails.
translations.idiomatic: those going to the Board of Appointments and awaiting selection mostly sigh in poverty, and conduct lacking integrity and shame prevails.

sentences.zh: 官冗之弊，一至於此！

translations.literal: The harm of official redundancy has reached this point!
translations.idiomatic: The harm of official redundancy has reached this point!

sentences.zh: 願陛下特詔，進士先取策論，諸科兼通經義，中第解褐，無令過多。

translations.literal: I wish Your Majesty would specially decree that jinshi candidates be first selected on policy essays, that other subjects also master classic meaning, that those who pass receive office but not in excessive numbers.
translations.idiomatic: I wish Your Majesty would decree that jinshi be selected first on policy essays, that other subjects master the classics, and that passers receive office but not in excessive numbers.

sentences.zh: 其文武班奏薦並流外出官者，權停五七年，自然名器不濫，奔競衰息矣。

translations.literal: For civil and military ranks recommended by memorial and for outside-entry officials, suspend them for five or seven years—then naturally honored posts will not be diluted and scrambling will decline.
translations.idiomatic: For civil and military ranks advanced by memorial and for outside-entry officials, suspend appointments for five or seven years—then honored posts will not be diluted and competition will fade.

sentences.zh: 陛下患牧守之職，罕聞奏最。

translations.literal: Your Majesty worries that in the duties of prefects and magistrates, one seldom hears of outstanding achievement.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty worries that among prefects and magistrates one seldom hears of outstanding achievement.

sentences.zh: 臣聞漢宣帝勉厲二千石，其有治效者，增秩賜金，或爵至關內侯，公卿缺，則以次用之，故良吏為盛。

translations.literal: Your servant has heard that Emperor Xuan of Han urged the two-thousand-bushel officials; those with governing merit had rank increased and gold bestowed, or were enfeoffed as marquis within the passes; when duke and minister posts were vacant, they were used in order—thus good officials flourished.
translations.idiomatic: I have heard that Emperor Xuan of Han urged his two-thousand-bushel officials; those who governed well received higher rank and gold, or were enfeoffed as marquis within the passes; when high posts fell vacant, they were filled in order—thus good officials flourished.

sentences.zh: 國家鑒諸侯專地之患，一切用郡守治之。

translations.literal: Our state, taking warning from the trouble of feudal lords holding territory exclusively, used prefects and magistrates to govern all.
translations.idiomatic: Our state, taking warning from feudal lords holding territory exclusively, governed everywhere through prefects and magistrates.

sentences.zh: 而班行寖冗，序遷者眾。

translations.literal: But the roster gradually grew redundant and those advanced in order were many.
translations.idiomatic: But the roster gradually grew redundant and those advanced in seniority were many.

sentences.zh: 乃有地處藩宣，秩為卿監，而未歷省府提轉，則為沈抑。

translations.literal: Thus there were those whose territory was a circuit commissioner's post and whose rank was that of a director or commissioner, yet who had not passed through provincial offices or transport and judicial posts and were therefore suppressed.
translations.idiomatic: Men might hold a circuit commissioner's territory and rank as director or commissioner yet never have served in provincial or transport and judicial posts, and were therefore held back.

sentences.zh: 內重外輕，何以求治？

translations.literal: The inner is heavy and the outer light—how can one seek good government?
translations.idiomatic: The center weighs heavy and the provinces light—how can good government be sought?

sentences.zh: 改弦易轍，正在此時。

translations.literal: To change the string and alter the rut—this is the time.
translations.idiomatic: To change course—now is the time.

sentences.zh: 願詔兩府大臣，選委兩制、臺諫官參舉，如兩任通判可充知州軍京朝官，依次除補。

translations.literal: I wish an edict to the two departments' great ministers to select and delegate Hanlin and remonstrance and censor officials to recommend jointly: if after two terms as vice-prefect one may fill a prefecture or army command as a capital official, appoint in order.
translations.idiomatic: I wish an edict charging the two departments' ministers to delegate Hanlin and remonstrance and censor officials to recommend jointly: capital officials who have served two terms as vice-prefect may fill prefecture and army commands, appointed in order.

sentences.zh: 若治狀尤異，即升省府提轉。

translations.literal: If governing achievement is especially outstanding, then promote to provincial offices or transport and judicial posts.
translations.idiomatic: If governing achievement is especially outstanding, promote them to provincial or transport and judicial posts.

sentences.zh: 其常例入知州者，一切停罷，則進擢得人，牧守重矣。

translations.literal: For those who enter prefectural government by routine precedent, stop all such appointments—then advancement will gain the right men and prefects and magistrates will be weighty.
translations.idiomatic: For those who become prefects by routine precedent alone, stop all such appointments—then advancement will gain capable men and prefects and magistrates will matter again.

sentences.zh: 陛下患將帥之任，艱於稱職。

translations.literal: Your Majesty worries that in the charge of generals and commanders, it is hard to find those who fit the post.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty worries that among generals and commanders few fit their posts.

sentences.zh: 臣聞晏子薦司馬穰苴曰：『文能附眾，武能威敵。』

translations.literal: Your servant has heard that Yanzi recommended Sima Rangju, saying: 'In civil matters he can win the multitude; in military matters he can awe the enemy.'
translations.idiomatic: I have heard that Yanzi recommended Sima Rangju, saying, 'In civil matters he can win the multitude; in military matters he can awe the enemy.'

sentences.zh: 是知將帥之材，非文武兼備，則不可為。

translations.literal: Thus one knows that the talent of a general is not fit unless civil and military are both complete.
translations.idiomatic: Thus one knows a general must combine civil and military excellence.

sentences.zh: 我朝自二邊款附，久不用兵。

translations.literal: Our court, since the two borders made peace and submitted, has long not used arms.
translations.idiomatic: Our court, since the two frontiers made peace, has long gone without war.

sentences.zh: 近歲有西北之警，補授帥臣，出於遽猝，非自卒伍，即恩澤侯。

translations.literal: In recent years with alarms in the northwest, commanders were appointed in haste—not from the ranks, then from favor and enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years, with alarms in the northwest, commanders were appointed in haste—not from the ranks but from favor and enfeoffment.

sentences.zh: 無信義以結士心，無莊嚴以正師律，退則奔北，進則被擒，虧損威靈，取侮夷狄，命將之失，未有若今之甚也。

translations.literal: Without faith and righteousness to bind soldiers' hearts, without stern dignity to correct military law—in retreat they flee north, in advance they are captured, damaging imperial majesty and inviting insult from barbarians; the failure in appointing generals has never been as great as today.
translations.idiomatic: Without faith and righteousness to bind soldiers' hearts, without stern dignity to enforce military law—in retreat they flee, in advance they are captured, damaging imperial majesty and inviting barbarian contempt; never has the failure in appointing generals been so grave.

sentences.zh: 願擇名臣，選舉深博有謀、知兵練武之士，不限資級，試以邊任，臨軒敦遣，假以威權，如祖宗朝任郭進、李漢超輩，閫外之事，俾得專之，無以謗讒輕有遷徙，使其足以取重，則安有不稱職之憂乎？

translations.literal: I wish to choose renowned ministers and select men of deep learning, counsel, and knowledge of war trained in arms, without limit of rank, try them in border posts, send them from the throne with earnest dispatch, lend them authority—as in the founding reigns when Guo Jin and Li Hanchao were entrusted, affairs outside the gate, let them have exclusive charge; do not lightly transfer them because of slander and malice, so that they may carry sufficient weight—then how could there be worry that they will not fit their posts?
translations.idiomatic: I wish renowned ministers would select men of deep learning, counsel, and military training, without limit of rank, try them on the frontier, send them from the throne with earnest dispatch, and lend them authority—as in the founding reigns when Guo Jin and Li Hanchao were entrusted with affairs beyond the gate with exclusive charge. Do not lightly transfer them because of slander and malice, so they may carry sufficient weight—then how could we fear they will not fit their posts?

sentences.zh: 陛下患西北多故，邊情叵測，獻奇譎空言者多，陳悠久實效者少，備豫不虞，理當先物。

translations.literal: Your Majesty worries that the northwest has many troubles, border conditions are hard to fathom, those who offer strange schemes and empty words are many and those who set forth lasting practical effects are few; to guard against the unforeseen, reason demands acting before events.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty worries that the northwest has many troubles, border conditions are hard to read, that strange schemes and empty words abound while lasting practical plans are few; guarding against the unforeseen demands acting before events.

sentences.zh: 臣聞國家和約北戎，爵命西夏，偃革止戈，逾四十載。

translations.literal: Your servant has heard that the state made peace with the northern Rong and enfeoffed Western Xia, laid down arms and ceased war—for more than forty years.
translations.idiomatic: I have heard that the state made peace with the northern tribes and enfeoffed Western Xia, laid down arms and ceased war—for more than forty years.

sentences.zh: 而守邊多任庸人，不嚴武備，因循姑息，為敵所窺，致元昊悖逆，耶律張皇。

translations.literal: Yet on the border mostly mediocre men are used, military preparations are not strict, indulgence and forbearance are followed, and the enemy observes us—leading to Yuan Hao's rebellion and the Liao house's arrogance.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the borders are mostly held by mediocre men, preparations are lax, indulgence prevails, and enemies observe us—leading to Yuan Hao's rebellion and Liao arrogance.

sentences.zh: 未免屈己為民，息兵講好，皆用苟安之謀，而無經遠之策。

translations.literal: We cannot but humble ourselves for the people, cease arms and seek peace—all use plans for temporary ease and have no long-range strategy.
translations.idiomatic: We cannot but humble ourselves for the people and seek peace—all use plans for temporary ease and lack long-range strategy.

sentences.zh: 此班固所謂『不選武略之臣，恃吾所以待寇而行貨賂，割剝百姓以奉寇仇』者也。

translations.literal: This is what Ban Gu called 'not choosing ministers of military strategy, relying on how we treat invaders to offer bribes, stripping the people to feed the enemy.'
translations.idiomatic: This is what Ban Gu called 'not choosing ministers of military strategy, relying on how we treat invaders to offer bribes, stripping the people to feed the enemy.'

sentences.zh: 願陛下特議減三路兵馬之駑冗者，以紓經費，以息科斂。

translations.literal: I wish Your Majesty would specially deliberate on reducing the feeble and redundant among the three circuits' troops and horses to relieve fiscal burdens and cease levies.
translations.idiomatic: I wish Your Majesty would deliberate on reducing the feeble and redundant among the three circuits' troops and horses to relieve fiscal burdens and cease levies.

sentences.zh: 然後選將帥，擇偏裨，使戢肅驕兵，飭利戎器，識山川形勝，用兵奇正。

translations.literal: Then choose generals and commanders, select deputies, make them restrain arrogant troops, sharpen weapons, know terrain and strategic points, and employ the odd and the straight in war.
translations.idiomatic: Then choose generals and deputies, restrain arrogant troops, sharpen weapons, know terrain and strategic points, and employ orthodox and unorthodox tactics.

sentences.zh: 河朔曠平，可施車陣，亦宜講求其法。

translations.literal: The Hebei north is broad and level—chariot formations may be deployed; their methods should also be studied.
translations.idiomatic: The Hebei north is broad and level—chariot formations may be deployed; their methods should also be studied.

sentences.zh: 雖二邊異時侵軼，恃吾有以待之，庶幾無患矣。」

translations.literal: Though the two borders at different times raid and encroach, relying on our preparedness, we may hope to be without trouble."
translations.idiomatic: Though the two frontiers raid at times, relying on our preparedness we may hope to be without trouble."

sentences.zh: 時執政及近臣所對多疏闊，仁宗頗嘉周詢詳敏。

translations.literal: At the time the replies of those in power and close ministers were mostly loose and shallow; Renzong greatly praised Zhouxun's detail and quickness.
translations.idiomatic: The replies of those in power and close ministers were mostly loose and shallow; Renzong greatly praised Zhouxun's detail and acuity.

sentences.zh: 知恩州張得一誅，坐失舉，出知永興軍；

translations.literal: Zhang Deyi, prefect of En Prefecture, was executed; Zhouxun was punished for a failed recommendation and sent out to govern Yongxing Army;
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Deyi, prefect of En Prefecture, was executed; Zhouxun was punished for a failed recommendation and sent out to govern Yongxing Army;

sentences.zh: 數日，改知成德軍，未行，卒。

translations.literal: after several days he was changed to govern Chengde Army; before he set out, he died.
translations.idiomatic: after several days he was reassigned to govern Chengde Army; before he set out, he died.

sentences.zh: 帝嗟悼之，特贈尚書工部侍郎。

translations.literal: The emperor sighed in mourning for him and specially posthumously granted him Vice Minister of the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor mourned him and specially posthumously granted him Vice Minister of the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 周詢性和易，聞見該洽，明吏事。

translations.literal: Zhouxun's nature was easygoing; his knowledge was comprehensive and he understood administrative affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Zhouxun was easygoing by nature, broadly learned, and skilled in administrative affairs.

sentences.zh: 在安州時，園吏見大蛇垂闌楯，即視之，乃周詢醉而假寐，世傳其異。

translations.literal: When in An Prefecture, a garden clerk saw a great snake draped over the balustrade; on looking closely it was Zhouxun drunk and feigning sleep—the world transmitted it as a marvel.
translations.idiomatic: While in An Prefecture, a garden clerk saw a great snake draped over the balustrade; on looking closely it was Zhouxun drunk and feigning sleep—people transmitted it as a marvel.

sentences.zh: 賈黯，字直孺，鄧州穰人。

translations.literal: Jia An, courtesy name Zhiru, was a native of Xiang in Deng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Jia An, whose courtesy name was Zhiru, came from Xiang in Deng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 擢進士第一，起家將作臨丞、通判襄州。

translations.literal: He was placed first in the jinshi examination, began his career as Vice Director of the Directorate of Palace Buildings and vice-prefect of Xiang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Placed first in the jinshi examination, he began as Vice Director of the Directorate of Palace Buildings and vice-prefect of Xiang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 還為秘書省著作佐郎、直集賢院，遷左正言、判三司開拆司。

translations.literal: On return he was made Editorial Assistant of the Secretariat and Attendant of the Hall for Assembling Worthies, transferred to Left Rectifier and adjudicator of the Three Offices Opening and Inspection Office.
translations.idiomatic: Recalled, he became Editorial Assistant of the Secretariat and Attendant of the Hall for Assembling Worthies, then Left Rectifier and adjudicator of the Three Offices Opening and Inspection Office.

sentences.zh: 黯自以年少遭遇，備位諫官，果於言事。

translations.literal: An considered himself young in advancement and filling the post of remonstrance officer; he was bold in speaking on affairs.
translations.idiomatic: An considered himself young in advancement yet filling a remonstrance post; he was bold in speaking on affairs.

sentences.zh: 首論韓琦、富弼、范仲淹可大用。

translations.literal: He first argued that Han Qi, Fu Bi, and Fan Zhongyan could be greatly employed.
translations.idiomatic: He first argued that Han Qi, Fu Bi, and Fan Zhongyan should be greatly employed.

sentences.zh: 杜樞覆張彥方獄，將駁正，忤執政意，執政以他罪絀樞。

translations.literal: Du Shu reviewed the Zhang Yanfang case and was about to overturn it, offending those in power; those in power punished Shu on another charge.
translations.idiomatic: Du Shu reviewed the Zhang Yanfang case and was about to overturn it, offending those in power, who punished Shu on another charge.

sentences.zh: 黯言：「樞無罪，且旨從中出，不因臣下彈奏。

translations.literal: An said: "Shu is without guilt, and moreover the order came from within and not because of officials' impeachment.
translations.idiomatic: An said, "Shu is innocent, and moreover the order came from within, not from officials' impeachment.

sentences.zh: 恐自此貴幸近習，言一得入，則將陰肆讒毀，害及善良，不可不察。」

translations.literal: I fear that from now on the honored and favored close attendants, once one word gains entry, will secretly slander and harm the good—we cannot but be watchful."
translations.idiomatic: I fear that henceforth honored favorites, once one word gains entry, will secretly slander and harm the good—we cannot fail to be watchful."

sentences.zh: 時言者或論事亡狀，輒戒勵窮詰。

translations.literal: At the time remonstrators sometimes discussed affairs without basis and were admonished and closely examined.
translations.idiomatic: At the time remonstrators sometimes discussed affairs without basis and were admonished and closely examined.

sentences.zh: 黯奏：「諫官、御史，跡既疏遠，未嘗預聞時政，不免采於傳聞，一有失言，而詰難沮辱隨之，非所以開廣言路。

translations.literal: An memorialized: "Remonstrance officers and censors, their tracks already distant, have never been privy to current policy and cannot but gather from rumor; one mistaken word and rebuke and humiliation follow—this is not how to open the path of speech.
translations.idiomatic: An memorialized, "Remonstrance officers and censors, already distant from court, have never been privy to current policy and must gather from rumor; one mistaken word brings rebuke and humiliation—this is not how to open the path of speech.

sentences.zh: 請如唐太宗用王珪、魏徵故事，每執政奏事，聽諫官一人隨入。」

translations.literal: I ask, as in Emperor Taizong of Tang employing Wang Gui and Wei Zheng, that whenever those in power memorialize affairs, one remonstrance officer be allowed to enter with them."
translations.idiomatic: I ask, following Emperor Taizong of Tang employing Wang Gui and Wei Zheng, that whenever those in power memorialize affairs, one remonstrance officer be allowed to enter with them."

sentences.zh: 執政又患言事官旅進，論議上前不肯止。

translations.literal: Those in power also worried that remonstrance officers advanced in groups and would not stop debating before the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Those in power also worried that remonstrance officers advanced in groups and would not stop debating before the throne.

sentences.zh: 乃詔：「凡欲合班上殿者，皆稟中書俟旨。」

translations.literal: Then an edict said: "All who wish to present memorials jointly at court must report to the Secretariat and await instruction."
translations.idiomatic: An edict then said, "All who wish to present joint memorials at court must report to the Secretariat and await instruction."

sentences.zh: 黯論以為：「今得進見言事者，獨諫官、御史，若然，言路將壅，陛下不得聞外事矣。

translations.literal: An argued: "Today those who may enter audience and speak on affairs are only remonstrance officers and censors; if so, the path of speech will be blocked and Your Majesty will not hear outside affairs.
translations.idiomatic: An argued, "Today only remonstrance officers and censors may enter audience to speak; if so, the path of speech will be blocked and Your Majesty will not hear outside affairs.

sentences.zh: 請如故便。」

translations.literal: I ask to restore the former convenience."
translations.idiomatic: I ask to restore the former practice."

sentences.zh: 皆弗許。

translations.literal: All were not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: All were denied.

sentences.zh: 儂智高反，余靖知桂州，楊畋安撫廣南東、西路，皆許便宜行事。

translations.literal: When Nong Zhigao rebelled, Yu Jing governed Gui Prefecture and Yang Tian pacified the Eastern and Western circuits of Guangnan; all were permitted to act at discretion.
translations.idiomatic: When Nong Zhigao rebelled, Yu Jing governed Gui Prefecture and Yang Tian pacified the Eastern and Western circuits of Guangnan; both were permitted to act at discretion.

sentences.zh: 黯言：「二人臨事，指蹤不一，則下將無所適從。

translations.literal: An said: "When the two men face affairs, if their directions are not one, subordinates will have nowhere to follow.
translations.idiomatic: An said, "When two men face affairs, if their directions differ, subordinates will not know whom to follow.

sentences.zh: 又靖專節制西路，若賊東向，則非靖所統，無以使眾，不若並付靖經制兩路。」

translations.literal: Moreover Jing exclusively commands the western circuit; if the bandits go east, that is not under Jing's command and he cannot deploy the multitude—it would be better to entrust both circuits to Jing."
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Jing commands only the western circuit; if bandits strike eastward he cannot deploy troops—it would be better to entrust both circuits to Jing."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was followed.
translations.idiomatic: The court agreed.

sentences.zh: 皇祐四年，同修起居注，徙判鹽鐵勾院，遷左司諫。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Huangyou he jointly compiled the Draft Diary, was transferred to adjudicator of the Salt and Iron Audit Office, and promoted to Left Remonstrance Officer.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Huangyou he jointly compiled the Draft Diary, was transferred to adjudicator of the Salt and Iron Audit Office, and promoted to Left Remonstrance Officer.

sentences.zh: 建言天下復置義倉，下其說諸路，而論者不一，黯亦反復辨析，卒不果行。

translations.literal: He proposed restoring charity granaries throughout the realm; his proposal was sent to the circuits, but debaters were not united and An also argued back and forth in analysis—in the end it was not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed restoring charity granaries throughout the realm; his proposal was sent to the circuits, but opinion was divided and An argued back and forth—in the end it was not carried out.

sentences.zh: 宰相劉沆請中外薦舉陳乞，一切以詔令從事，毋用例。

translations.literal: Chief Councillor Liu Kang requested that recommendations and petitions from within and without the court all follow edicts and precedents not be used.
translations.idiomatic: Chief Councillor Liu Kang proposed that all recommendations and petitions from inside and outside court follow edicts alone, without relying on precedent.

sentences.zh: 論者以為非便，黯奏罷之。

translations.literal: Discussants thought it inconvenient; An memorialized to abolish it.
translations.idiomatic: Critics found the proposal inconvenient; An memorialized to abolish it.

sentences.zh: 狄青除樞密副使，黯言：「國初武臣宿將，扶建大業，平定列國，有忠勳者，不可勝數。

translations.literal: Di Qing was appointed Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs. An said: "At the founding, veteran military officials who helped establish the great enterprise and pacified the various states—those with loyal merit cannot be counted.
translations.idiomatic: When Di Qing was appointed Vice Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, An said, "At the founding, veteran military officials who helped establish the dynasty and pacified the states—men of loyal merit beyond counting—

sentences.zh: 然未有以卒伍登帷幄者。」

translations.literal: Yet never has one from the ranks ascended to the command tent."
translations.idiomatic: yet never has a man risen from the ranks to the command tent."

sentences.zh: 不報。

translations.literal: No reply was given.
translations.idiomatic: No reply was given.

sentences.zh: 會靈觀災，又言：「天意所欲廢，當罷營繕，赦守衛者罪，以示儆懼修省之意。」

translations.literal: When the Huiling Abbey burned, he again said: "What Heaven wishes abolished—construction should cease, the guards' crimes should be pardoned, to show fear and caution in self-examination."
translations.idiomatic: When the Huiling Abbey burned, he again said, "What Heaven wishes abolished—construction should cease and the guards' crimes be pardoned, to show fear and self-examination."

sentences.zh: 擢知制誥。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Drafting Gentleman.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Drafting Gentleman.

sentences.zh: 初，仁宗視事退，御邇英閣，召侍臣講讀，而修起居注官獨先出。

translations.literal: Initially, when Renzong finished audience and retired to the Ziying Pavilion to summon attendant ministers for lectures, the Draft Diary officer alone left first.
translations.idiomatic: At first, when Renzong finished audience and retired to the Ziying Pavilion to summon ministers for lectures, the Draft Diary officer alone left first.

sentences.zh: 黯言：「君臣訪對，動關政體，而史臣不得預聞，請並召侍經筵。」

translations.literal: An said: "When ruler and minister inquire and reply, it touches the body of government, yet the historiographer may not hear in advance—I ask that lecturers at the classics mat also be summoned."
translations.idiomatic: An said, "When ruler and minister inquire and reply, it touches the body of government, yet the historiographer may not hear in advance—I ask that lecturers at the classics mat also be summoned."

sentences.zh: 許之。

translations.literal: It was permitted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 初，邇英、延義二閣，講讀官自有記注。

translations.literal: Initially the Ziying and Yanyi pavilions had their own record-keepers for lecturers.
translations.idiomatic: At first the Ziying and Yanyi pavilions had their own record-keepers for lecturers.

sentences.zh: 至是，乃罷焉。

translations.literal: At this point that practice was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Now that practice was abolished.

sentences.zh: 直龍圖閣錢延年擢天章閣待制，黯當命辭，即詆延年不才，不宜污侍從，封詞目還中書，命遂寢。

translations.literal: Qian Yannian, Attendant of the Dragon Diagram Hall, was promoted to Hanlin Attendant of the Heavenly Writings Hall; An was to draft the appointment edict and at once denounced Yannian as incompetent, unfit to stain the attendant ranks, sealed the draft and returned it to the Secretariat—the appointment then lapsed.
translations.idiomatic: Qian Yannian, Attendant of the Dragon Diagram Hall, was promoted to Hanlin Attendant of the Heavenly Writings Hall; An was to draft the edict but denounced Yannian as incompetent, unfit for attendant rank, sealed the draft and returned it to the Secretariat—and the appointment lapsed.

sentences.zh: 判吏部流內銓。

translations.literal: He adjudicated the Board of Personnel's Outside-Register Office.
translations.idiomatic: He adjudicated the Board of Personnel's Outside-Register Office.

sentences.zh: 益州推官桑澤父留鄉里，死三年矣。

translations.literal: Sang Ze, a judicial officer of Yizhou, left his father in the countryside; the father had been dead three years.
translations.idiomatic: Sang Ze, a judicial officer of Yizhou, had left his father in the countryside; the father had been dead three years.

sentences.zh: 澤為弗知者而調京師，既覺而去。

translations.literal: Ze transferred to the capital as if unaware, and once he realized it he left.
translations.idiomatic: Ze transferred to the capital as if unaware; once he realized it he fled.

sentences.zh: 黯奏劾，廢終身。

translations.literal: An memorialized for impeachment and barred him for life.
translations.idiomatic: An memorialized for impeachment and barred him from office for life.

sentences.zh: 福州推官劉抃挾數術，言人禍福，多遊公卿門，黯奏以為靈臺郎。

translations.literal: Liu Bian, a judicial officer of Fuzhou, relied on numerology, spoke of people's fortune and misfortune, and often visited the gates of dukes and ministers; An memorialized to make him an officer of the Astrological Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Bian, a judicial officer of Fuzhou, relied on numerology, foretold people's fortunes, and often visited noble gates; An memorialized to make him an officer of the Astrological Bureau.

sentences.zh: 時詔兩制、兩省官唯公事許至中書、樞密院見執政，群臣心知其非，而嫌於自言。

translations.literal: At the time an edict said that Hanlin and provincial officials might visit the Secretariat and Bureau of Military Affairs to see those in power only on public business; the multitude knew it was wrong but shrank from speaking for themselves.
translations.idiomatic: An edict then allowed Hanlin and provincial officials to visit the Secretariat and Bureau of Military Affairs only on public business; officials knew it was wrong but shrank from speaking up.

sentences.zh: 後黯知許州，乃言：「他官皆得見執政，而侍從近臣，反疏斥疑間如此。

translations.literal: Later when An governed Xu Prefecture he said: "Other officials may all see those in power, yet attendant close ministers are thus distanced and suspected in this way.
translations.idiomatic: Later, governing Xu Prefecture, An said, "Other officials may see those in power, yet attendant close ministers are distanced and suspected in this way.

sentences.zh: 嘗聞先朝用王禹偁請，百官候謁宰相，並於政事堂，樞密使亦須聚坐接見，以防請託，令下，左正言謝泌上書，以謂非人主推赤心待大臣，大臣展四體報人主之誼。」

translations.literal: I once heard that in the former reign Wang Yucheng's request was used—all officials waiting to pay respects to the chief councillor assembled in the Hall of Administration, and the Bureau Commissioner also had to sit together to receive them, to guard against solicitation—when the order was issued, Left Rectifier Xie Mi memorialized that this was not how a ruler shows an open heart to great ministers or how great ministers extend their full loyalty to the ruler."
translations.idiomatic: I once heard that in a former reign Wang Yucheng's request was adopted—all officials waiting to pay respects to the chief councillor assembled in the Hall of Administration, and the Bureau Commissioner also sat to receive them, to guard against solicitation. When the order was issued, Left Rectifier Xie Mi memorialized that this was not how a ruler shows an open heart to great ministers or how ministers extend full loyalty to the ruler."

sentences.zh: 即時追寢前詔。

translations.literal: At once the earlier edict was withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: The earlier edict was at once withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 徙襄州，迎父之官，而父有故人在部中，遣直廳卒致問。

translations.literal: Transferred to Xiang Prefecture, he brought his father to office; his father had an old friend in the department who sent a direct-hall soldier to convey greetings.
translations.idiomatic: Transferred to Xiang Prefecture, he brought his father to office; his father had an old friend in the department who sent a direct-hall soldier to convey greetings.

sentences.zh: 黯輒笞卒，父恚，一夕歸鄉里。

translations.literal: An at once caned the soldier; his father was angry and in one night returned to his home village.
translations.idiomatic: An at once caned the soldier; his father was angry and returned home overnight.

sentences.zh: 他日，疾且亟，黯內懷不自安，請徙郡及解官就養。

translations.literal: Another day, when his illness was severe and urgent, An inwardly felt ill at ease and requested transfer to another prefecture and dismissal from office to nurse his parent.
translations.idiomatic: When his father grew gravely ill, An inwardly felt ill at ease and requested transfer and dismissal to nurse him.

sentences.zh: 不報，乃棄官去。

translations.literal: No reply was given; he then abandoned office and left.
translations.idiomatic: No reply came; he then abandoned office and left.

sentences.zh: 而御史吳中復等劾黯輒委州印，撓朝廷法，絀知郢州。

translations.literal: Censor Wu Zhongfu and others impeached An for rashly abandoning the prefectural seal and disturbing court law; he was demoted to govern Ying Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Censor Wu Zhongfu and others impeached An for rashly abandoning the prefectural seal and disturbing court law; he was demoted to govern Ying Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 未及行，父死。

translations.literal: Before he set out, his father died.
translations.idiomatic: Before he set out, his father died.

sentences.zh: 服除，勾當三班院，為翰林學士。

translations.literal: When mourning ended he managed the Three-Rank Court and became Hanlin Academician.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning ended he managed the Three-Rank Court and became Hanlin Academician.

sentences.zh: 唐介等坐言陳升之不當柄用，皆外補。

translations.literal: Tang Jie and others were punished for speaking against Chen Shengzhi's unsuitability to wield power—all were sent out to supplemental posts.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Jie and others were punished for speaking against Chen Shengzhi's unsuitability to wield power—all were sent to supplemental posts.

sentences.zh: 黯奏介等敢言，請寬之。

translations.literal: An memorialized that Jie and others dared to speak and asked that they be leniently treated.
translations.idiomatic: An memorialized that Jie and others dared to speak and asked leniency for them.

sentences.zh: 以疾請郡，改侍讀學士、知鄧州。

translations.literal: He requested a prefecture on grounds of illness and was changed to Lecturing Academician governing Deng Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Citing illness he requested a prefecture and was made Lecturing Academician governing Deng Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 未行，疾愈，復以為翰林學士、知審官院。

translations.literal: Before he set out his illness healed; he was again made Hanlin Academician and managed the Court of Official Appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Before he set out his illness healed; he was again made Hanlin Academician and managed the Court of Official Appointment.

sentences.zh: 時官吏有以祖父嫌名，援律為請授他官。

translations.literal: At the time some officials, because of their grandfathers' taboo names, cited the law to request appointment to other offices.
translations.idiomatic: Some officials, citing their grandfathers' taboo names, invoked the law to request other appointments.

sentences.zh: 黯言：「禮不諱嫌名，二名不偏諱，律：『府號、官稱犯祖父名而冒榮居之，又上書若奏事犯祖廟諱，罪皆有差。』

translations.literal: An said: "In ritual one does not avoid homophone taboo; for two-character names one does not avoid one character. The law: 'If office title or post name violates the grandfather's name yet one accepts honor and holds it, or if in memorials one violates the ancestral temple taboo, penalties differ in degree.
translations.idiomatic: An said, "Ritual does not avoid homophone taboo; for two-character names one does not avoid a single character. The law states: 'If office title violates the grandfather's name yet one accepts honor, or if memorials violate ancestral taboo, penalties differ.

sentences.zh: 又曰：『若嫌名及二名偏犯者，不坐。』

translations.literal: It also says: 'If homophone taboo or partial violation of a two-character name, one is not punished.'
translations.idiomatic: It also says: 'For homophone taboo or partial violation of a two-character name, one is not punished.'

sentences.zh: 今官吏許避嫌名，則或有如此而不自言者，可坐以冒榮之律乎？

translations.literal: Now if officials are permitted to avoid homophone taboo, then some may be in such cases yet not speak—can they be punished under the law of accepting honor improperly?
translations.idiomatic: If officials may avoid homophone taboo, some may be in such cases yet not speak—can they be punished for improperly accepting honor?

sentences.zh: 國朝雍熙中，嘗詔：『除官犯私諱者，三省御史臺五品、文班四品以上，許用式奏改，餘不在此制。』

translations.literal: In our dynasty in the Yongxi era there was once an edict: 'For appointments violating private taboo, from the Three Departments, Censorate, fifth rank and above, and civil fourth rank and above, memorial revision by formula is permitted; the rest are not under this rule.'
translations.idiomatic: In the Yongxi era there was an edict: 'For appointments violating private taboo, from the Three Departments, Censorate, fifth rank and above, and civil fourth rank and above, revision by formula is permitted; the rest are outside this rule.'

sentences.zh: 請約雍熙詔書，自某品而上，以禮律從事。」

translations.literal: I ask to follow the Yongxi edict—from a certain rank upward, follow ritual and law."
translations.idiomatic: I ask to follow the Yongxi edict—from a certain rank upward, follow ritual and law."

sentences.zh: 詔非嫌名及二名，不以品秩高下皆聽避。

translations.literal: An edict said: except for homophone taboo and two-character names, regardless of rank all may avoid.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ruled: except for homophone taboo and two-character names, all ranks may avoid regardless of status.

sentences.zh: 累遷尚書左司郎中、權知開封府。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Left Department Gentleman with acting authority over Kaifeng.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly promoted to Left Department Gentleman with acting authority over Kaifeng.

sentences.zh: 兩軍獄囚歲瘐死者眾，而吏不任其責。

translations.literal: Among prisoners of the two armies many died of plague yearly, yet the clerks did not bear responsibility.
translations.idiomatic: Among prisoners of the two armies many died of plague yearly, yet clerks bore no responsibility.

sentences.zh: 黯言：「吏或怠於視囚，饑渴疾病，因以致死，請歲計死者多少而賞罰之。」

translations.literal: An said: "If clerks neglect watching prisoners and hunger, thirst, or illness cause death, count yearly deaths and reward or punish."
translations.idiomatic: An said, "If clerks neglect prisoners and hunger, thirst, or illness cause death, count yearly deaths and reward or punish."

sentences.zh: 府吏額七百人，以罪廢復敘者，皆數外補之，黯請敘者須有闕乃補。

translations.literal: The prefectural staff quota was seven hundred men; those dismissed for crime and restored by amnesty were all supplemented beyond quota—An asked that restorations require a vacancy.
translations.idiomatic: The prefectural staff quota was seven hundred; those dismissed and restored by amnesty were all supplemented beyond quota—An asked that restorations require a vacancy.

sentences.zh: 然所斷治，或出己見，人不以為允。

translations.literal: Yet in judgments he sometimes followed his own view, and people did not consider it fair.
translations.idiomatic: Yet in judgments he sometimes followed his own view, and people did not consider it fair.

sentences.zh: 御史中丞王疇與其屬陳經、呂誨、傅堯俞，諫官司馬光、龔鼎臣、王陶，皆言黯剛愎自任，赦書下府，罪應釋者反重行之。

translations.literal: Vice Censor-in-Chief Wang Chou and his subordinates Chen Jing, Lu Hui, and Fu Yaoyu, remonstrators Sima Guang, Gong Dingchen, and Wang Tao—all said An was stubborn and self-willed; when amnesty edicts reached the prefecture, those who should be released he instead punished more heavily.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Censor-in-Chief Wang Chou and subordinates Chen Jing, Lu Hui, and Fu Yaoyu, remonstrators Sima Guang, Gong Dingchen, and Wang Tao—all said An was stubborn and self-willed; when amnesty edicts reached the prefecture, those who should be released he punished more heavily instead.

sentences.zh: 罷為同提舉在京諸司庫務。

translations.literal: He was dismissed to jointly manage metropolitan storehouses.
translations.idiomatic: He was dismissed to jointly manage metropolitan storehouses.

sentences.zh: 英宗即位，遷中書舍人。

translations.literal: When Yingzong took the throne, An was transferred to Secretariat Drafter.
translations.idiomatic: When Yingzong took the throne, An was transferred to Secretariat Drafter.

sentences.zh: 受詔撰《仁宗實錄》，權知審刑院，為群牧使。

translations.literal: He received orders to compile the Veritable Records of Renzong, acted over the Court of Judicial Review, and became Commissioner of the Herd Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: He received orders to compile the Veritable Records of Renzong, acted over the Court of Judicial Review, and became Commissioner of the Herd Bureau.

sentences.zh: 時封拜皇子，並除檢校太傅。

translations.literal: At the time imperial sons were enfeoffed and all appointed Acting Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial sons were enfeoffed and all appointed Acting Grand Tutor.

sentences.zh: 黯言：「太師、太傅、太保，是為三師，天子之所師法。

translations.literal: An said: "Grand Preceptor, Grand Tutor, and Grand Guardian are the Three Preceptors—the Son of Heaven's teachers.
translations.idiomatic: An said, "Grand Preceptor, Grand Tutor, and Grand Guardian are the Three Preceptors—the Son of Heaven's teachers.

sentences.zh: 子為父師，於義不可，蓋前世因循弗思之過。

translations.literal: A son as father's teacher is wrong in principle—this is surely a fault of former ages carried on without reflection.
translations.idiomatic: A son as his father's teacher is wrong in principle—surely a fault of former ages carried on unthinkingly.

sentences.zh: 請自今皇子及宗室屬卑者，皆毋兼師傅官，隨其遷序，改授三公。」

translations.literal: I ask that from now on imperial sons and junior clansmen all not concurrently hold tutor posts; with their advancement in order, change to the Three Dukes."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that henceforth imperial sons and junior clansmen not concurrently hold tutor posts; with advancement in order, grant the Three Dukes instead."

sentences.zh: 下兩制議，請如黯奏，而中書亦謂：「自唐以來，親王無兼師傅者。

translations.literal: It was sent to the two Hanlin academies for deliberation; they asked to follow An's memorial, and the Secretariat also said: "Since Tang times imperial sons have not concurrently held tutor posts.
translations.idiomatic: The two Hanlin academies deliberated and asked to follow An's memorial; the Secretariat also said, "Since Tang times imperial sons have not concurrently held tutor posts.

sentences.zh: 國朝以三師、三公皆虛名，故因而授之，宜正其失。」

translations.literal: Our dynasty, since the Three Preceptors and Three Dukes are empty titles, has therefore granted them—this error should be corrected."
translations.idiomatic: Our dynasty, since the Three Preceptors and Three Dukes are empty titles, has granted them anyway—this error should be corrected."

sentences.zh: 詔可。

translations.literal: The edict approved.
translations.idiomatic: The edict approved.

sentences.zh: 遷給事中、權御史中丞。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Drafting Attendant with acting authority as Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Drafting Attendant with acting authority as Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 未幾，以呂誨知雜事，誨嘗彈治黯，逡巡引避，黯言嘗薦誨為御史，知其方正謹厚，一時公言，非有嫌怨，願終與共事，誨乃就職。

translations.literal: Before long Lu Hui was made Attending Censor with supervisory duties; Hui had once impeached An, hesitated and withdrew—An said he had once recommended Hui as censor, knowing him upright and careful, the public voice of the time without personal grudge, and wished to serve with him to the end—Hui then took office.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Lu Hui was made Attending Censor with supervisory duties; Hui had once impeached An and hesitated to serve—An said he had recommended Hui as censor, knowing him upright and careful, the public voice without personal grudge, and wished to serve with him to the end—Hui then took office.

sentences.zh: 時帝初即位，王廣淵、周孟陽以藩邸之舊，數召對。

translations.literal: At the time the emperor had newly taken the throne; Wang Guangyuan and Zhou Mengyang, old associates of the princely residence, were repeatedly summoned for audience.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor had newly taken the throne; Wang Guangyuan and Zhou Mengyang, old associates of the princely residence, were repeatedly summoned.

sentences.zh: 黯言：「俊乂滿朝，未有一被召者，獨親近一二舊人，示天下以不廣。

translations.literal: An said: "Talented men fill the court—never has one been summoned—only one or two old intimates are favored, showing the realm a narrow heart.
translations.idiomatic: An said, "Talented men fill the court—never has one been summoned—only one or two old intimates are favored, showing the realm a narrow heart.

sentences.zh: 請如太宗故事，召侍從館閣之臣，以備顧問。」

translations.literal: I ask, as in Taizong's precedent, to summon attendant and pavilion scholars to prepare for consultation."
translations.idiomatic: I ask, following Taizong's precedent, to summon attendant and pavilion scholars for consultation."

sentences.zh: 帝嘗從容謂黯曰：「朕欲用人，少可任者。」

translations.literal: The emperor once said casually to An: "I wish to employ men but few are fit."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor once said to An, "I wish to employ men but few seem fit."

sentences.zh: 黯對：「天下未嘗乏人，顧所用如何爾。」

translations.literal: An replied: "The realm has never lacked men—it depends on how they are used."
translations.idiomatic: An replied, "The realm has never lacked men—it depends on how they are used."

sentences.zh: 退而上五事：一、知人之明，二、養育以漸，三、材不求備，四、以類薦舉，五、擇取自代。

translations.literal: On retiring he submitted five points: first, discerning knowledge of men; second, nurturing gradually; third, not requiring talent to be complete; fourth, recommending by category; fifth, choosing successors oneself.
translations.idiomatic: Retiring, he submitted five points: discerning knowledge of men; nurturing gradually; not requiring complete talent; recommending by category; choosing successors oneself.

sentences.zh: 後與兩制合議，請以濮王為皇伯，執政弗從，數詣中書爭論。

translations.literal: Later with the two Hanlin academies he jointly deliberated asking that the Prince of Pu be made Imperial Uncle; those in power did not follow and he repeatedly went to the Secretariat to argue.
translations.idiomatic: Later, with the two Hanlin academies, he asked that the Prince of Pu be made Imperial Uncle; those in power refused and he repeatedly argued at the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 會大雨水，時黯已被疾，疏言：「簡宗廟，逆天時，則水不潤下。

translations.literal: When great rain came he was already ill and memorialized: "Simplifying the ancestral temples and opposing Heaven's season—then water does not moisten below.
translations.idiomatic: When great rains came he was already ill and memorialized, "Simplifying the ancestral temples and opposing Heaven's season—then water does not moisten below.

sentences.zh: 今二三執政，知陛下為先帝後，乃阿諛容說，違背經義，建兩統貳父之說，故七廟神靈震怒，天降雨水，流殺人民。」

translations.literal: Now two or three in power, knowing Your Majesty is heir to the former emperor, yet flatter and speak accommodating words, violate canonical principle, establish the theory of two fathers with two lords—therefore the spirits of the seven temples are angered, Heaven sends rain, and people are swept away."
translations.idiomatic: Now two or three in power, knowing Your Majesty is heir to the former emperor, yet flatter and accommodate, violate canonical principle, and establish two fathers with two lords—therefore the spirits of the seven temples are angered, Heaven sends rain, and people are swept away."

sentences.zh: 既病，求出，以翰林侍讀學士知陳州。

translations.literal: Already ill, he asked to leave and was made Hanlin Lecturing Academician governing Chen Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Already ill, he asked to leave and was made Hanlin Lecturing Academician governing Chen Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 未行，卒，年四十四。

translations.literal: Before he set out he died, age forty-four.
translations.idiomatic: Before he set out he died, aged forty-four.

sentences.zh: 口占遺奏數百言，猶以濮王議為請。

translations.literal: Orally he left a final memorial of several hundred words, still pleading on the Prince of Pu affair.
translations.idiomatic: Orally he left a final memorial of several hundred words, still pleading on the Prince of Pu affair.

sentences.zh: 贈尚書禮部侍郎。

translations.literal: He was posthumously granted Vice Minister of the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously granted Vice Minister of the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 初，黯母陳歸宗，繼母史在堂，後迎陳歸，二母不相善，黯能安以事之。

translations.literal: Initially An's mother Chen returned to the clan; stepmother Shi remained in the hall; later Chen was welcomed back—the two mothers were not on good terms, yet An could settle them with proper conduct.
translations.idiomatic: An's mother Chen had returned to her clan; stepmother Shi remained in the hall; when Chen was welcomed back the two mothers were not on good terms, yet An settled them with proper conduct.

sentences.zh: 黯修潔自喜，在朝數言事，或從或否，人稱其介直。

translations.literal: An cultivated himself and took pleasure in his integrity; in court he often spoke on affairs, sometimes followed and sometimes not—people called him upright and direct.
translations.idiomatic: An cultivated himself and prized integrity; in court he often spoke, sometimes heeded and sometimes not—people called him upright and direct.

sentences.zh: 然卞急，初通判襄州，疑優人戲己，以人茵啖之。

translations.literal: Yet he was impetuous; when first vice-prefect of Xiang Prefecture he suspected actors were mocking him and had a man eat a cushion.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he was impetuous; as vice-prefect of Xiang Prefecture he suspected actors mocked him and had a man eat a cushion.

sentences.zh: 在開封，為罪人所詈，又啖以人茵，言者亦以是詆之。

translations.literal: In Kaifeng a criminal cursed him and he again fed him a cushion; remonstrators also criticized him for this.
translations.idiomatic: In Kaifeng a criminal cursed him and he again fed him a cushion; remonstrators criticized this too.

sentences.zh: 李京，字伯升，趙州人。

translations.literal: Li Jing, courtesy name Bosheng, was a native of Zhao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jing, whose courtesy name was Bosheng, came from Zhao Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 進士中第，歷平定軍判官、冀州推官，改大理寺丞、知魏縣。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination, successively served as adjutant of Pingding Army and judicial officer of Ji Prefecture, was changed to Director of the Court of Judicial Review and governed Wei County.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi, served as adjutant of Pingding Army and judicial officer of Ji Prefecture, then became Director of the Court of Judicial Review and governed Wei County.

sentences.zh: 奉法嚴正，吏不便，欲以苛中京，遂相率遁去。

translations.literal: Upholding the law strictly and correctly, the clerks found it inconvenient and wished to catch him in harshness; they then fled together.
translations.idiomatic: Upholding the law strictly, clerks found him inconvenient and wished to trap him in harshness; they fled together.

sentences.zh: 監司果議以苛刻斥京，知府任布曰：「如此，適墮吏計中。」

translations.literal: The supervisory commissioner indeed deliberated dismissing Jing for harshness; Prefect Ren Bu said: "If so, we fall right into the clerks' scheme."
translations.idiomatic: The supervisory commissioner deliberated dismissing Jing for harshness; Prefect Ren Bu said, "If so, we fall into the clerks' scheme."

sentences.zh: 京賴以免。

translations.literal: Jing thereby escaped punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Jing thereby escaped punishment.

sentences.zh: 徙永昌縣，通判趙州。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Yongchang County and vice-prefect of Zhao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Yongchang County and vice-prefect of Zhao Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 王拱辰薦為監察御史裏行，遷監察御史。

translations.literal: Wang Gongchen recommended him as Investigating Censor with acting authority and he was transferred to Investigating Censor.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Gongchen recommended him as Investigating Censor with acting authority; he became Investigating Censor.

sentences.zh: 時太史言日當食不食，群臣皆賀。

translations.literal: At the time the Grand Astrologer said the sun should be eclipsed but was not; the multitude all congratulated.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Astrologer said the sun should be eclipsed but was not; all congratulated.

sentences.zh: 京上疏曰：「陛下因天之戒，恐懼修省，避正殿，減常膳，故精意感格，日當食而陰雲蔽虧。

translations.literal: Jing memorialized: "Your Majesty, taking Heaven's warning, fears and reforms, avoids the main hall and reduces regular meals—therefore refined intent moved the realm; the day should have been eclipsed but clouds covered and obscured it.
translations.idiomatic: Jing memorialized, "Your Majesty, taking Heaven's warning, fears and reforms, avoids the main hall and reduces meals—therefore refined intent moved the realm; the day should have eclipsed but clouds obscured it.

sentences.zh: 雖宋景公之熒惑退舍，商大戊之桑穀並枯，無以異也。

translations.literal: Though it differs not from Duke Jing of Song's retreat of the Fire Star or Grand Yi Ding's withering mulberry and grain together.
translations.idiomatic: Though this differs not from Duke Jing of Song's Fire Star retreat or Grand Yi Ding's withering mulberry and grain.

sentences.zh: 然臣區區竊有所疑者，自寶元初，定襄地震，壞城郭，覆廬舍，壓死者以數萬人。

translations.literal: Yet your servant privately has doubts: from the beginning of Baoyuan, Ding and Xiang earthquake shook city walls, overturned houses, and crushed tens of thousands dead.
translations.idiomatic: Yet I privately doubt: from Baoyuan's beginning, Ding and Xiang earthquakes shook walls, overturned houses, and crushed tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 殆今十年，震動不已，豈非西、北二邊，有窺中國之意乎？

translations.literal: Nearly ten years now, shaking has not ceased—is it not that the northwest and north borders harbor intent to spy on China?
translations.idiomatic: Nearly ten years shaking has not ceased—is it not that the northwest and north borders harbor intent to spy on China?

sentences.zh: 二月雷發聲，在《易》為《豫》，言萬物出地，皆悅豫也。

translations.literal: In the second month thunder sounded—in the Changes this is Yu, saying all things leave the earth and are joyful.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month thunder sounded—in the Changes this is Yu, when all things leave the earth in joy.

sentences.zh: 八月收聲，在《易》為《歸妹》，言雷聲入地，避群陰之害也。

translations.literal: In the eighth month sound is gathered—in the Changes this is Gui Mei, saying thunder enters the earth to avoid harm from yin.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month sound is gathered—in the Changes this is Gui Mei, when thunder enters the earth to avoid yin harm.

sentences.zh: 今孟夏雷未發聲，豈非號令不信乎？

translations.literal: Now in early summer thunder has not sounded—is it not that commands are not trusted?
translations.idiomatic: Now in early summer thunder has not sounded—is it not that commands lack trust?

sentences.zh: 願陛下飭邊臣備夷狄，戒輔臣慎出命，以厭禍於未形。

translations.literal: I wish Your Majesty would discipline border officials against barbarians and warn assisting ministers to be careful in issuing orders, to quell disaster before it takes form.
translations.idiomatic: I wish Your Majesty would discipline border officials against barbarians and warn ministers to be careful issuing orders, to quell disaster before it forms.

sentences.zh: 又尚美人棄外館多年，比聞復召入，臣慮假媚道以為蠱惑，宜亟絕之。

translations.literal: Moreover the Lady Shang abandoned the outer residence for many years; recently I hear she was again summoned—I fear by false charming ways to bewitch; she should quickly be cut off.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Lady Shang abandoned the outer residence for years; I hear she was again summoned—I fear false charm to bewitch; she should quickly be cut off.

sentences.zh: 苗繼宗嬪御子弟，乃緣恩私，為府界提點。

translations.literal: Miao Jizong, a son of the imperial concubine's household, received favor and became metropolitan frontier intendant.
translations.idiomatic: Miao Jizong, of the imperial concubine's household, received favor and became metropolitan frontier intendant.

sentences.zh: 宜割帷薄之愛，重名器之分，庶幾不累聖政。」

translations.literal: Your Majesty should cut curtain intimacy and weight the distinction of honored posts—then perhaps holy government will not be burdened."
translations.idiomatic: Cut curtain intimacy and weight honored posts—then perhaps government will not be burdened."

sentences.zh: 仁宗嘉納，授右正言、直集賢院、同管勾國子監，加史館修撰。

translations.literal: Renzong praised and accepted it; he was made Right Rectifier, Attendant of the Hall for Assembling Worthies, and jointly managed the Directorate of Education, with added Draft Historian.
translations.idiomatic: Renzong praised and accepted; he was made Right Rectifier, Attendant of the Hall for Assembling Worthies, jointly managed the Directorate of Education, with added Draft Historian.

sentences.zh: 數上書論事，宰相賈昌朝不悅。

translations.literal: He repeatedly memorialized on affairs; Chief Councillor Jia Changchao was displeased.
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly memorialized; Chief Councillor Jia Changchao was displeased.

sentences.zh: 京嘗屬侍御史吳鼎臣薦推直官李實，鼎臣希昌朝意，以告中丞高若訥。

translations.literal: Jing once asked Attending Censor Wu Dingchen to recommend judicial officer Li Shi; Dingchen followed Changchao's intent and told Vice Censor-in-Chief Gao Ruone.
translations.idiomatic: Jing once asked Attending Censor Wu Dingchen to recommend judicial officer Li Shi; Dingchen followed Changchao's intent and told Vice Censor-in-Chief Gao Ruone.

sentences.zh: 若訥為鼎臣上京簡，謫京太常博士、監鄂州稅。

translations.literal: Ruone memorialized for Dingchen on Jing's brief and demoted Jing to Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices supervising E Prefecture tax.
translations.idiomatic: Ruone memorialized on Jing's brief and demoted him to Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices supervising E Prefecture tax.

sentences.zh: 既至，引令狐亙、錢徽事，言：「臣為御史諫官，首尾五年，凡六上章、四親對，自陳疾故，懇求外補。

translations.literal: On arrival he cited the cases of Linghu Heng and Qian Hui: "Your servant as censor and remonstrator, from first to last five years, six memorials and four personal audiences; I stated illness and earnestly sought outside appointment.
translations.idiomatic: On arrival he cited Linghu Heng and Qian Hui: "As censor and remonstrator for five years I submitted six memorials and had four personal audiences; citing illness I sought outside appointment.

sentences.zh: 臣之出處，粗有本末。

translations.literal: Your servant's coming and going has a rough beginning and end.
translations.idiomatic: My coming and going has a rough beginning and end.

sentences.zh: 向者在臺，見《入閣圖》，三院御史立班各異。

translations.literal: Formerly in the Censorate I saw the Entering Audience diagram—the three bureaus' censors stood in ranks each different.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly in the Censorate I saw the Entering Audience diagram—the three bureaus' censors stood in different ranks.

sentences.zh: 聞元日將入閣，而御史王贄、何郯皆謁告歸。

translations.literal: I heard that on New Year's Day they would enter audience, yet Censors Wang Zan and He Yan both requested leave and returned.
translations.idiomatic: I heard that on New Year's Day they would enter audience, yet Censors Wang Zan and He Yan both took leave.

sentences.zh: 會推直官李實歲將滿，因簡鼎臣宜留實補御史，鼎臣亦謂議協公望，不意逾兩月，乃誣臣與實為朋黨。

translations.literal: When Judicial Officer Li Shi's term was nearly full I briefly asked Dingchen to retain Shi to supplement the censors; Dingchen also said the proposal accorded with public expectation—who expected that after more than two months he would falsely accuse me and Shi of faction.
translations.idiomatic: When Judicial Officer Li Shi's term was nearly full I asked Dingchen to retain Shi as censor; Dingchen said the proposal accorded with public expectation—who expected that after two months he would falsely accuse Shi and me of faction.

sentences.zh: 臣初被黜，閱諸橐中，鼎臣所遺私書別紙故在，臣令男諶亟悉焚毀。

translations.literal: When first demoted I looked through my bags—the private letters Dingchen sent on separate paper are still there; I had my son Chen burn them all at once.
translations.idiomatic: When first demoted I found Dingchen's private letters still in my bags; I had my son Chen burn them all.

sentences.zh: 臣與實僚友，鼎臣鄉曲之舊，鼎臣為御史，臣延譽推引，實有力焉。

translations.literal: Shi and I are colleagues; Dingchen is an old acquaintance from our home district—when Dingchen was censor I praised and recommended him, and Shi had real force in it.
translations.idiomatic: Shi and I are colleagues; Dingchen is a home-district acquaintance—when he was censor I praised and recommended him, and Shi had real force in it.

sentences.zh: 待之不疑，因以誠告，豈謂傾險包藏，甘為鷹犬，惟陛下察之。」

translations.literal: I treated him without suspicion and therefore spoke sincerely—who knew he would treacherously harbor malice, willing to be a hawk and hound? I beg Your Majesty to examine this."
translations.idiomatic: I treated him without suspicion and spoke sincerely—who knew he would treacherously harbor malice and play hawk and hound? I beg Your Majesty to examine this."

sentences.zh: 未幾，卒官。

translations.literal: Before long he died in office.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he died in office.

sentences.zh: 詔錄諶為郊社齋郎。

translations.literal: An edict enrolled Chen as suburban-sacrifice Acolyte.
translations.idiomatic: An edict enrolled Chen as suburban-sacrifice Acolyte.

sentences.zh: 吳鼎臣

translations.literal: Wu Dingchen
translations.idiomatic: Wu Dingchen

translations.literal: 〈Attached〉
translations.idiomatic: 〈Attached〉

sentences.zh: 鼎臣，棣州人。

translations.literal: Dingchen was a native of Di Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Dingchen came from Di Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 既逐京，會昌朝罷，夏竦自北京召為相。

translations.literal: After driving out Jing, when Changchao was dismissed Xia Song was summoned from Beijing to be chief councillor.
